title: Chat And Goal Production Kernel Migration
invariants: Kernel run_end is published exactly once and only after surface-owned terminal persistence and quiescent drain complete.
Chat preserves request idempotency, same-session serialization, persisted assistant output, stream terminal parity, continuation recovery, and required activity persistence.
Goal preserves milestone run records, trajectory order, checkpoints, pause and cancel settlement, acceptance certificates, plan lineage, and canonical terminal publication.
Every tool call continues through ToolRuntime, ToolAuthorizationService, workspace guards, and the existing OS sandbox.
Scheduled Task behavior and the immutable v3.8.2 release remain unchanged while Chat and Goal migrate.
Each production cutover has an explicit off switch until post-migration review and stress gates pass.
nonGoals: No Context event compaction without measured pressure evidence.
No external subagent provider without an approved product and trust-boundary decision.
No arbitrary Code Mode or model-authored mutation runtime in this program.
No cloud worker, permission bypass, storage rewrite, or unreviewed self-modification.

deferredCapabilities.currentEvidence: RC11 passed 25000 Context events plus replay in 89 ms and 10000 Chat messages in 456 ms on the recorded baseline.
deferredCapabilities.trigger: Consider compaction only after repeatable stress or production telemetry demonstrates nonlinear replay memory, a breached stress budget, or user-visible p95 startup or turn latency attributable to Context event volume.
deferredCapabilities.prohibitedCurrentAction: Do not add compaction formats, destructive pruning, or replacement-event rewriting during Kernel migration.

deferredCapabilities.currentEvidence: The product has no approved requirement to send delegated task context to an external subagent service.
deferredCapabilities.trigger: Proceed only with an approved product requirement covering provider value, user consent, data residency, credentials, cost, observability, cancellation, and ToolRuntime-equivalent permissions.
deferredCapabilities.prohibitedCurrentAction: Do not add cloud workers, hidden delegation, or a provider-specific bypass around Actor and ToolRuntime contracts.

deferredCapabilities.currentEvidence: Current Code Mode is intentionally a typed read-only DAG executed by a resource-limited Worker and workspace-scoped tools.
deferredCapabilities.trigger: Reconsider only after a separate process isolation design proves syscall, filesystem, network, credential, child-process, timeout, kill, audit, and capability-only I/O boundaries with adversarial tests.
deferredCapabilities.prohibitedCurrentAction: Do not add eval, Function, VM escape surfaces, arbitrary shell, mutating nested tools, or in-process model-authored code execution.
